title: ficus nervosa subsp. pubinervis
intro: Ficus nervosa subsp. pubinervis, commonly known as Indian Banyan, is a type of fig tree native to tropical Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system, exert antioxidant effects, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ficus nervosa subsp. pubinervis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
